author: vYuri
body:
Firts: If I say something wrong please let me know.

I think in this community many current people playing are very good in themselves, the differences in other communities is irrelevant, in my opinion the people of Avicus is one of the best experiences that I still have. I say thank you for being part of it and help the community in every sense, I know. I'm nobody with a high rank for saying this but honestly there are things that I have to clarify, thanks.

- Yuri
